content: iOS PWA push: only installed home-screen apps (16.4+); permission from user gesture; every push must showNotification inside event.waitUntil or Safari revokes subscription after ~3 silent pushes; pushsubscriptionchange not fired on iOS so re-sync subscription on every app open; notificationclick openWindow deep links unreliable on iOS (opens root / previous page) - app must query server for pending call state on launch; VAPID sub must be real mailto/https (localhost -> 403 BadJwtToken from web.push.apple.com); Declarative Web Push exists (iOS 18.4+).
